content.english: Ant. The gall is a healing to the eyes, but the virtue of the heart and the liver putteth the power of the devil to flight.

segments.t: Ant.
Lúmina fel sanat, sed virtus cordis et iécoris diáboli expéllit potestátem.

content.latin: Ant. Est hic Sara * Raguélis fília; quæ tibi coniúgio dábitur, et omnis substántia eius.
content.english: Ant. Here is Sara * the daughter of Raguel, who shall be given unto thee to wife, and all her substance with her.

segments.t: Ant.
Est hic Sara * Raguélis fília; quæ tibi coniúgio dábitur, et omnis substántia eius.

content.latin: Psalmus 95 [7]
content.english: Psalm 95 [7]

segments.t: Psalmus 95

content.latin: 95:1 Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * cantáte Dómino, omnis terra.
content.english: 95:1 Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * sing to the Lord, all the earth.

segments.t: Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * cantáte Dómino, omnis terra.

content.latin: 95:2 Cantáte Dómino, et benedícite nómini eius: * annuntiáte de die in diem salutáre eius.
content.english: 95:2 Sing ye to the Lord and bless his name: * shew forth his salvation from day to day.

segments.t: Cantáte Dómino, et benedícite nómini eius: * annuntiáte de die in diem salutáre eius.

content.latin: 95:3 Annuntiáte inter gentes glóriam eius, * in ómnibus pópulis mirabília eius.
content.english: 95:3 Declare his glory among the Gentiles: * his wonders among all people.

segments.t: Annuntiáte inter gentes glóriam eius, * in ómnibus pópulis mirabília eius.

content.latin: 95:4 Quóniam magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * terríbilis est super omnes deos.
content.english: 95:4 For the Lord is great, and exceedingly to be praised: * he is to be feared above all gods.

segments.t: Quóniam magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * terríbilis est super omnes deos.

content.latin: 95:5 Quóniam omnes dii géntium dæmónia: * Dóminus autem cælos fecit.
content.english: 95:5 For all the gods of the Gentiles are devils: * but the Lord made the heavens.

segments.t: Quóniam omnes dii géntium dæmónia: * Dóminus autem cælos fecit.

content.latin: 95:6 Conféssio, et pulchritúdo in conspéctu eius: * sanctimónia et magnificéntia in sanctificatióne eius.
content.english: 95:6 Praise and beauty are before him: * holiness and majesty in his sanctuary.

segments.t: Conféssio, et pulchritúdo in conspéctu eius: * sanctimónia et magnificéntia in sanctificatióne eius.

content.latin: 95:7 Afférte Dómino, pátriæ géntium, afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem: * afférte Dómino glóriam nómini eius.
content.english: 95:7 Bring ye to the Lord, O ye kindreds of the Gentiles, bring ye to the Lord glory and honour: * bring to the Lord glory unto his name.

segments.t: Afférte Dómino, pátriæ géntium, afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem: * afférte Dómino glóriam nómini eius.

content.latin: 95:8 Tóllite hóstias, et introíte in átria eius: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto eius.
content.english: 95:8 Bring up sacrifices, and come into his courts: * adore ye the Lord in his holy court.

segments.t: Tóllite hóstias, et introíte in átria eius: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto eius.

content.latin: 95:9 Commoveátur a fácie eius univérsa terra: * dícite in géntibus quia Dóminus regnávit.
content.english: 95:9 Let all the earth be moved at his presence. * Say ye among the Gentiles, the Lord hath reigned.

segments.t: Commoveátur a fácie eius univérsa terra: * dícite in géntibus quia Dóminus regnávit.

content.latin: 95:10 Étenim corréxit orbem terræ qui non commovébitur: * iudicábit pópulos in æquitáte.
content.english: 95:10 For he hath corrected the world, which shall not be moved: * he will judge the people with justice.

segments.t: Étenim corréxit orbem terræ qui non commovébitur: * iudicábit pópulos in æquitáte.

content.latin: 95:11 Læténtur cæli, et exsúltet terra: commoveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: * gaudébunt campi, et ómnia quæ in eis sunt.
content.english: 95:11 Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad, let the sea be moved, and the fulness thereof: * the fields and all things that are in them shall be joyful.

segments.t: Læténtur cæli, et exsúltet terra: commoveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: * gaudébunt campi, et ómnia quæ in eis sunt.

content.latin: 95:12 Tunc exsultábunt ómnia ligna silvárum a fácie Dómini, quia venit: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.
content.english: 95:12 Then shall all the trees of the woods rejoice before the face of the Lord, because he cometh: * because he cometh to judge the earth.

segments.t: Tunc exsultábunt ómnia ligna silvárum a fácie Dómini, quia venit: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.

content.latin: 95:13 Iudicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, * et pópulos in veritáte sua.
content.english: 95:13 He shall judge the world with justice, * and the people with his truth.

segments.t: Iudicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, * et pópulos in veritáte sua.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Est hic Sara Raguélis fília; quæ tibi coniúgio dábitur, et omnis substántia eius.
content.english: Ant. Here is Sara the daughter of Raguel, who shall be given unto thee to wife, and all her substance with her.

segments.t: Ant.
Est hic Sara Raguélis fília; quæ tibi coniúgio dábitur, et omnis substántia eius.

content.latin: Ant. Septem viros hábuit, * quos dæmónium oppréssit; tímeo ne mihi símile contíngat.
content.english: Ant. She hath had seven husbands, * who were all strangled by an evil spirit; I am afraid lest the like should befall me.

segments.t: Ant.
Septem viros hábuit, * quos dæmónium oppréssit; tímeo ne mihi símile contíngat.

content.latin: Psalmus 96 [8]
content.english: Psalm 96 [8]

segments.t: Psalmus 96

content.latin: 96:1 Dóminus regnávit, exsúltet terra: * læténtur ínsulæ multæ.
content.english: 96:1 The Lord hath reigned, let the earth rejoice: * let many islands be glad.

segments.t: Dóminus regnávit, exsúltet terra: * læténtur ínsulæ multæ.

content.latin: 96:2 Nubes, et calígo in circúitu eius: * iustítia, et iudícium corréctio sedis eius.
content.english: 96:2 Clouds and darkness are round about him: * justice and judgment are the establishment of his throne.

segments.t: Nubes, et calígo in circúitu eius: * iustítia, et iudícium corréctio sedis eius.

content.latin: 96:3 Ignis ante ipsum præcédet, * et inflammábit in circúitu inimícos eius.
content.english: 96:3 A fire shall go before him, * and shall burn his enemies round about.

segments.t: Ignis ante ipsum præcédet, * et inflammábit in circúitu inimícos eius.

content.latin: 96:4 Illuxérunt fúlgura eius orbi terræ: * vidit, et commóta est terra.
content.english: 96:4 His lightnings have shone forth to the world: * the earth saw and trembled.

segments.t: Illuxérunt fúlgura eius orbi terræ: * vidit, et commóta est terra.

content.latin: 96:5 Montes, sicut cera fluxérunt a fácie Dómini: * a fácie Dómini omnis terra.
content.english: 96:5 The mountains melted like wax, at the presence of the Lord: * at the presence of the Lord of all the earth.

segments.t: Montes, sicut cera fluxérunt a fácie Dómini: * a fácie Dómini omnis terra.

content.latin: 96:6 Annuntiavérunt cæli iustítiam eius: * et vidérunt omnes pópuli glóriam eius.
content.english: 96:6 The heavens declared his justice: * and all people saw his glory.

segments.t: Annuntiavérunt cæli iustítiam eius: * et vidérunt omnes pópuli glóriam eius.

content.latin: 96:7 Confundántur omnes, qui adórant sculptília: * et qui gloriántur in simulácris suis.
content.english: 96:7 Let them be all confounded that adore graven things, * and that glory in their idols.

segments.t: Confundántur omnes, qui adórant sculptília: * et qui gloriántur in simulácris suis.

content.latin: 96:7 Adoráte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * audívit, et lætáta est Sion.
content.english: 96:7 Adore him, all you his angels: * Sion heard, and was glad.

segments.t: Adoráte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * audívit, et lætáta est Sion.

content.latin: 96:8 Et exsultavérunt fíliæ Iudæ, * propter iudícia tua, Dómine:
content.english: 96:8 And the daughters of Juda rejoiced, * because of thy judgments, O Lord.

segments.t: Et exsultavérunt fíliæ Iudæ, * propter iudícia tua, Dómine:

content.latin: 96:9 Quóniam tu Dóminus Altíssimus super omnem terram: * nimis exaltátus es super omnes deos.
content.english: 96:9 For thou art the most high Lord over all the earth: * thou art exalted exceedingly above all gods.

segments.t: Quóniam tu Dóminus Altíssimus super omnem terram: * nimis exaltátus es super omnes deos.

content.latin: 96:10 Qui dilígitis Dóminum, odíte malum: * custódit Dóminus ánimas sanctórum suórum, de manu peccatóris liberábit eos.
content.english: 96:10 You that love the Lord, hate evil: * the Lord preserveth the souls of his saints, he will deliver them out of the hand of the sinner.

segments.t: Qui dilígitis Dóminum, odíte malum: * custódit Dóminus ánimas sanctórum suórum, de manu peccatóris liberábit eos.

content.latin: 96:11 Lux orta est iusto, * et rectis corde lætítia.
content.english: 96:11 Light is risen to the just, * and joy to the right of heart.

segments.t: Lux orta est iusto, * et rectis corde lætítia.

content.latin: 96:12 Lætámini, iusti, in Dómino: * et confitémini memóriæ sanctificatiónis eius.
content.english: 96:12 Rejoice, ye just, in the Lord: * and give praise to the remembrance of his holiness.

segments.t: Lætámini, iusti, in Dómino: * et confitémini memóriæ sanctificatiónis eius.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Septem viros hábuit, quos dæmónium oppréssit; tímeo ne mihi símile contíngat.
content.english: Ant. She hath had seven husbands, who were all strangled by an evil spirit; I am afraid lest the like should befall me.

segments.t: Ant.
Septem viros hábuit, quos dæmónium oppréssit; tímeo ne mihi símile contíngat.

content.latin: Ant. Per tres dies * oratióni cum uxóre tua vacábis, ut in sémine Abrahæ benedictiónem in fíliis consequáris.
content.english: Ant. Spend three days * in prayer with thy wife, that thou mayest obtain the blessing of sons, in the seed of Abraham.

segments.t: Ant.
Per tres dies * oratióni cum uxóre tua vacábis, ut in sémine Abrahæ benedictiónem in fíliis consequáris.

content.latin: Psalmus 102 [9]
content.english: Psalm 102 [9]

segments.t: Psalmus 102

content.latin: 102:1 Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et ómnia, quæ intra me sunt, nómini sancto eius.
content.english: 102:1 Bless the Lord, O my soul: * and let all that is within me bless his holy name.

segments.t: Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et ómnia, quæ intra me sunt, nómini sancto eius.

content.latin: 102:2 Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et noli oblivísci omnes retributiónes eius.
content.english: 102:2 Bless the Lord, O my soul, * and never forget all he hath done for thee.

segments.t: Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et noli oblivísci omnes retributiónes eius.

content.latin: 102:3 Qui propitiátur ómnibus iniquitátibus tuis: * qui sanat omnes infirmitátes tuas.
content.english: 102:3 Who forgiveth all thy iniquities: * who healeth all thy diseases.

segments.t: Qui propitiátur ómnibus iniquitátibus tuis: * qui sanat omnes infirmitátes tuas.

content.latin: 102:4 Qui rédimit de intéritu vitam tuam: * qui corónat te in misericórdia et miseratiónibus.
content.english: 102:4 Who redeemeth thy life from destruction: * who crowneth thee with mercy and compassion.

segments.t: Qui rédimit de intéritu vitam tuam: * qui corónat te in misericórdia et miseratiónibus.

content.latin: 102:5 Qui replet in bonis desidérium tuum: * renovábitur ut áquilæ iuvéntus tua:
content.english: 102:5 Who satisfieth thy desire with good things: * thy youth shall be renewed like the eagle’s.

segments.t: Qui replet in bonis desidérium tuum: * renovábitur ut áquilæ iuvéntus tua:

content.latin: 102:6 Fáciens misericórdias Dóminus: * et iudícium ómnibus iniúriam patiéntibus.
content.english: 102:6 The Lord doth mercies, * and judgment for all that suffer wrong.

segments.t: Fáciens misericórdias Dóminus: * et iudícium ómnibus iniúriam patiéntibus.

content.latin: 102:7 Notas fecit vias suas Móysi, * fíliis Israël voluntátes suas.
content.english: 102:7 He hath made his ways known to Moses: * his wills to the children of Israel.

segments.t: Notas fecit vias suas Móysi, * fíliis Israël voluntátes suas.

content.latin: 102:8 Miserátor, et miséricors Dóminus: * longánimis, et multum miséricors.
content.english: 102:8 The Lord is compassionate and merciful: * longsuffering and plenteous in mercy.

segments.t: Miserátor, et miséricors Dóminus: * longánimis, et multum miséricors.

content.latin: 102:9 Non in perpétuum irascétur: * neque in ætérnum comminábitur.
content.english: 102:9 He will not always be angry: * nor will he threaten for ever.

segments.t: Non in perpétuum irascétur: * neque in ætérnum comminábitur.

content.latin: 102:10 Non secúndum peccáta nostra fecit nobis: * neque secúndum iniquitátes nostras retríbuit nobis.
content.english: 102:10 He hath not dealt with us according to our sins: * nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

segments.t: Non secúndum peccáta nostra fecit nobis: * neque secúndum iniquitátes nostras retríbuit nobis.

content.latin: 102:11 Quóniam secúndum altitúdinem cæli a terra: * corroborávit misericórdiam suam super timéntes se.
content.english: 102:11 For according to the height of the heaven above the earth: * he hath strengthened his mercy towards them that fear him.

segments.t: Quóniam secúndum altitúdinem cæli a terra: * corroborávit misericórdiam suam super timéntes se.

content.latin: 102:12 Quantum distat ortus ab occidénte: * longe fecit a nobis iniquitátes nostras.
content.english: 102:12 As far as the east is from the west, * so far hath he removed our iniquities from us.

segments.t: Quantum distat ortus ab occidénte: * longe fecit a nobis iniquitátes nostras.

content.latin: 102:13 Quómodo miserétur pater filiórum, misértus est Dóminus timéntibus se: * quóniam ipse cognóvit figméntum nostrum.
content.english: 102:13 As a father hath compassion on his children, so hath the Lord compassion on them that fear him: * for he knoweth our frame.

segments.t: Quómodo miserétur pater filiórum, misértus est Dóminus timéntibus se: * quóniam ipse cognóvit figméntum nostrum.

content.latin: 102:14 Recordátus est quóniam pulvis sumus: * homo, sicut fænum dies eius, tamquam flos agri sic efflorébit.
content.english: 102:14 He remembereth that we are dust: * man’s days are as grass, as the flower of the field so shall he flourish.

segments.t: Recordátus est quóniam pulvis sumus: * homo, sicut fænum dies eius, tamquam flos agri sic efflorébit.

content.latin: 102:16 Quóniam spíritus pertransíbit in illo, et non subsístet: * et non cognóscet ámplius locum suum.
content.english: 102:16 For the spirit shall pass in him, and he shall not be: * and he shall know his place no more.

segments.t: Quóniam spíritus pertransíbit in illo, et non subsístet: * et non cognóscet ámplius locum suum.

content.latin: 102:17 Misericórdia autem Dómini ab ætérno, * et usque in ætérnum super timéntes eum.
content.english: 102:17 But the mercy of the Lord is from eternity * and unto eternity upon them that fear him:

segments.t: Misericórdia autem Dómini ab ætérno, * et usque in ætérnum super timéntes eum.

content.latin: 102:17 Et iustítia illíus in fílios filiórum, * his qui servant testaméntum eius:
content.english: 102:17 And his justice unto children’s children, * to such as keep his covenant,

segments.t: Et iustítia illíus in fílios filiórum, * his qui servant testaméntum eius:

content.latin: 102:18 Et mémores sunt mandatórum ipsíus, * ad faciéndum ea.
content.english: 102:18 And are mindful of his commandments * to do them.

segments.t: Et mémores sunt mandatórum ipsíus, * ad faciéndum ea.

content.latin: 102:19 Dóminus in cælo parávit sedem suam: * et regnum ipsíus ómnibus dominábitur.
content.english: 102:19 The Lord hath prepared his throne in heaven: * and his kingdom shall rule over all.

segments.t: Dóminus in cælo parávit sedem suam: * et regnum ipsíus ómnibus dominábitur.

content.latin: 102:20 Benedícite Dómino, omnes Ángeli eius: * poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum eius.
content.english: 102:20 Bless the Lord, all ye his angels: * you that are mighty in strength, and execute his word, hearkening to the voice of his orders.

segments.t: Benedícite Dómino, omnes Ángeli eius: * poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum eius.

content.latin: 102:21 Benedícite Dómino, omnes virtútes eius: * minístri eius, qui fácitis voluntátem eius.
content.english: 102:21 Bless the Lord, all ye his hosts: * you ministers of his that do his will.

segments.t: Benedícite Dómino, omnes virtútes eius: * minístri eius, qui fácitis voluntátem eius.

content.latin: 102:22 Benedícite Dómino, ómnia ópera eius: * in omni loco dominatiónis eius, bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
content.english: 102:22 Bless the Lord, all his works: * in every place of his dominion, O my soul, bless thou the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite Dómino, ómnia ópera eius: * in omni loco dominatiónis eius, bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Per tres dies oratióni cum uxóre tua vacábis, ut in sémine Abrahæ benedictiónem in fíliis consequáris.
content.english: Ant. Spend three days in prayer with thy wife, that thou mayest obtain the blessing of sons, in the seed of Abraham.

segments.t: Ant.
Per tres dies oratióni cum uxóre tua vacábis, ut in sémine Abrahæ benedictiónem in fíliis consequáris.

content.latin: ℣. Apprehéndit Angelus Ráphaël dæmónium.
content.english: ℣. The Angel Raphael took hold on the evil spirit.

segments.t: Apprehéndit Angelus Ráphaël dæmónium.

content.latin: ℟. Et religávit illud in desérto superióris Ægýpti.
content.english: ℟. And drove him away into the desert of Upper Egypt.

segments.t: Et religávit illud in desérto superióris Ægýpti.

content.latin: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
content.english: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

segments.t: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris:
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.

content.latin: ℣. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
content.english: ℣. And lead us not into temptation:

segments.t: Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:

content.latin: ℟. Sed líbera nos a malo.
content.english: ℟. But deliver us from evil.

segments.t: Sed líbera nos a malo.

content.latin: Absolutio. A vínculis peccatórum nostrórum absólvat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus.
content.english: Absolution. May the Almighty and merciful Lord loose us from the bonds of our sins.

segments.t: Absolutio.
A vínculis peccatórum nostrórum absólvat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Ille nos benedícat, qui sine fine vivit et regnat.
content.english: Benediction. May His blessing be upon us who doth live and reign for ever.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Ille nos benedícat, qui sine fine vivit et regnat.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: De libro Tobíæ
content.english: From the Book of Tobias

content.latin: 1 Vocávit ad se Tobías fílium suum, dixítque ei: Quid póssumus dare viro isti sancto, qui venit tecum?
content.english: 1 Then Tobias called to him his son, and said to him: What can we give to this holy man, that is come with thee?

segments.t: Vocávit ad se Tobías fílium suum, dixítque ei: Quid póssumus dare viro isti sancto, qui venit tecum?

content.latin: 2 Respóndens Tobías, dixit patri suo: Pater, quam mercédem dábimus ei? aut quid dignum póterit esse benefíciis eius?
content.english: 2 Tobias answering, said to his father: Father, what wages shall we give him? or what can be worthy of his benefits?

segments.t: Respóndens Tobías, dixit patri suo: Pater, quam mercédem dábimus ei? aut quid dignum póterit esse benefíciis eius?

content.latin: 3 Me duxit et redúxit sanum, pecúniam a Gabélo ipse recépit, uxórem ipse me habére fecit, et dæmónium ab ea ipse compéscuit: gáudium paréntibus eius fecit, meípsum a devoratióne piscis erípuit, te quoque vidére fecit lumen cæli, et bonis ómnibus per eum repléti sumus. Quid illi ad hæc potérimus dignum dare?
content.english: 3 He conducted me and brought me safe again, he received the money of Gabelus, he caused me to have my wife, and he chased from her the evil spirit, he gave joy to her parents, myself he delivered from being devoured by the fish, thee also he hath made to see the light of heaven, and we are filled with all good things through him. What can we give him sufficient for these things?

segments.t: Me duxit et redúxit sanum, pecúniam a Gabélo ipse recépit, uxórem ipse me habére fecit, et dæmónium ab ea ipse compéscuit: gáudium paréntibus eius fecit, meípsum a devoratióne piscis erípuit, te quoque vidére fecit lumen cæli, et bonis ómnibus per eum repléti sumus. Quid illi ad hæc potérimus dignum dare?

content.latin: 4 Sed peto te, pater mi, ut roges eum, si forte dignábitur medietátem de ómnibus quæ alláta sunt, sibi assúmere.
content.english: 4 But I beseech thee, my father, to desire him, that he would vouchsafe to accept one half of all things that have been brought.

segments.t: Sed peto te, pater mi, ut roges eum, si forte dignábitur medietátem de ómnibus quæ alláta sunt, sibi assúmere.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟. In illo témpore exaudítæ sunt preces ambórum in conspéctu glóriæ summi Dei:
content.english: ℟. At that time the prayers of them twain were heard in the presence of the glory of the Most High God;

segments.t: In illo témpore exaudítæ sunt preces ambórum in conspéctu glóriæ summi Dei:

content.latin: * Et missus est Angelus Dómini sanctus Ráphaël, ut curáret eos ambos, quorum uno témpore sunt oratiónes in conspéctu Dómini recitátæ.
content.english: * And holy Raphael, the Angel of the Lord, was sent to heal the twain of them, whose prayers had been uttered at one time in the presence of the Lord.

content.latin: ℣. Tobías et Sara in tribulatióne pósiti cum lácrimis oráre cœpérunt.
content.english: ℣. Tobias and Sara were in tribulation, and began to pray with tears.

segments.t: Tobías et Sara in tribulatióne pósiti cum lácrimis oráre cœpérunt.

content.latin: ℟. Et missus est Angelus Dómini sanctus Ráphaël, ut curáret eos ambos, quorum uno témpore sunt oratiónes in conspéctu Dómini recitátæ.
content.english: ℟. And holy Raphael, the Angel of the Lord, was sent to heal the twain of them, whose prayers had been uttered at one time in the presence of the Lord.

segments.t: Et missus est Angelus Dómini sanctus Ráphaël, ut curáret eos ambos, quorum uno témpore sunt oratiónes in conspéctu Dómini recitátæ.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Cuius festum cólimus, ipse intercédat pro nobis ad Dóminum.
content.english: Benediction. He whose feast-day we are keeping, be our Advocate with God.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Cuius festum cólimus, ipse intercédat pro nobis ad Dóminum.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: 5 Et vocántes eum, pater scílicet et fílius, tulérunt eum in partem; et rogáre cœpérunt ut dignarétur dimídiam partem ómnium quæ attúlerant, accéptam habére.
content.english: 5 So the father and the son, calling him, took him aside: and began to desire him that he would vouchsafe to accept of half of all things that they had brought.

segments.t: Et vocántes eum, pater scílicet et fílius, tulérunt eum in partem; et rogáre cœpérunt ut dignarétur dimídiam partem ómnium quæ attúlerant, accéptam habére.

content.latin: 6 Tunc dixit eis occúlte: Benedícite Deum cæli, et coram ómnibus vivéntibus confitémini ei, quia fecit vobíscum misericórdiam suam.
content.english: 6 Then he said to them secretly: Bless ye the God of heaven, give glory to him in the sight of all that live, because he hath shewn his mercy to you.

segments.t: Tunc dixit eis occúlte: Benedícite Deum cæli, et coram ómnibus vivéntibus confitémini ei, quia fecit vobíscum misericórdiam suam.

content.latin: 7 Etenim sacraméntum regis abscóndere bonum est, ópera autem Dei reveláre et confitéri honoríficum est.
content.english: 7 For it is good to hide the secret of a king: but honourable to reveal and confess the works of God.

segments.t: Etenim sacraméntum regis abscóndere bonum est, ópera autem Dei reveláre et confitéri honoríficum est.

content.latin: 8 Bona est orátio cum ieiúnio, et eleemósyna magis quam thesáuros auri recóndere;
content.english: 8 Prayer is good with fasting and alms more than to lay up treasures of gold:

segments.t: Bona est orátio cum ieiúnio, et eleemósyna magis quam thesáuros auri recóndere;

content.latin: 9 Quóniam eleemósyna a morte líberat, et ipsa est quæ purgat peccáta, et facit inveníre misericórdiam et vitam ætérnam.
content.english: 9 For alms delivereth from death, and the same is that which purgeth away sins, and maketh to find mercy and life everlasting.

segments.t: Quóniam eleemósyna a morte líberat, et ipsa est quæ purgat peccáta, et facit inveníre misericórdiam et vitam ætérnam.

content.latin: 10 Qui autem fáciunt peccátum et iniquitátem, hostes sunt ánimæ suæ.
content.english: 10 But they that commit sin and iniquity, are enemies to their own soul.

segments.t: Qui autem fáciunt peccátum et iniquitátem, hostes sunt ánimæ suæ.

content.latin: 11 Manifésto ergo vobis veritátem et non abscóndam a vobis occúltum sermónem.
content.english: 11 I discover then the truth unto you, and I will not hide the secret from you.

segments.t: Manifésto ergo vobis veritátem et non abscóndam a vobis occúltum sermónem.

content.latin: 12 Quando orábas cum lácrimis, et sepeliébas mórtuos, et derelinquébas prándium tuum, et mórtuos abscondébas per diem in domo tua, et nocte sepeliébas eos, ego óbtuli oratiónem tuam Dómino.
content.english: 12 When thou didst pray with tears, and didst bury the dead, and didst leave thy dinner, and hide the dead by day in thy house, and bury them by night, I offered thy prayer to the Lord.

segments.t: Quando orábas cum lácrimis, et sepeliébas mórtuos, et derelinquébas prándium tuum, et mórtuos abscondébas per diem in domo tua, et nocte sepeliébas eos, ego óbtuli oratiónem tuam Dómino.

content.latin: 13 Et quia accéptus eras Deo, necésse fuit ut tentátio probáret te.
content.english: 13 And because thou wast acceptable to God, it was necessary that temptation should prove thee.

segments.t: Et quia accéptus eras Deo, necésse fuit ut tentátio probáret te.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟. Egréssus Tobías invénit iúvenem spléndidum stantem præcínctum, et quasi parátum ad ambulándum, et salutávit eum, et dixit:
content.english: ℟. When Tobias went forth he found a very well-favoured young man standing with his loins girded, and as it were ready to set forth, and he saluted him and said:

segments.t: Egréssus Tobías invénit iúvenem spléndidum stantem præcínctum, et quasi parátum ad ambulándum, et salutávit eum, et dixit:

content.latin: * Unde te habémus, bone iúvenis?
content.english: * Whence art thou, O good young man?

content.latin: ℣. Et, ignórans quod Dómini Angelus esset, salutávit eum, et dixit.
content.english: ℣. And he knew not that it was an Angel of the Lord, and saluted him, and said:

segments.t: Et, ignórans quod Dómini Angelus esset, salutávit eum, et dixit.

content.latin: ℟. Unde te habémus, bone iúvenis?
content.english: ℟. Whence art thou, O good young man?

segments.t: Unde te habémus, bone iúvenis?

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Unde te habémus, bone iúvenis?
content.english: ℟. Whence art thou, O good young man?

segments.t: Unde te habémus, bone iúvenis?

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Ad societátem cívium supernórum perdúcat nos Rex Angelórum.
content.english: Benediction. May He that is the Angels' King to that high realm His people bring.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Ad societátem cívium supernórum perdúcat nos Rex Angelórum.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: 14 Et nunc misit me Dóminus ut curárem te, et Saram uxórem fílii tui a dæmónio liberárem;
content.english: 14 And now the Lord hath sent me to heal thee, and to deliver Sara thy son's wife from the devil.

segments.t: Et nunc misit me Dóminus ut curárem te, et Saram uxórem fílii tui a dæmónio liberárem;

content.latin: 15 Ego enim sum Ráphaël Angelus, unus ex septem qui astámus ante Dóminum.
content.english: 15 For I am the angel Raphael, one of the seven, who stand before the Lord.

segments.t: Ego enim sum Ráphaël Angelus, unus ex septem qui astámus ante Dóminum.

content.latin: 16 Cumque hæc audíssent, turbáti sunt, et treméntes cecidérunt super terram in fáciem suam.
content.english: 16 And when they had heard these things, they were troubled, and being seized with fear they fell upon the ground on their face.

segments.t: Cumque hæc audíssent, turbáti sunt, et treméntes cecidérunt super terram in fáciem suam.

content.latin: 17 Dixítque eis Angelus: Pax vobis, nolíte timére.
content.english: 17 And the angel said to them: Peace be to you, fear not.

segments.t: Dixítque eis Angelus: Pax vobis, nolíte timére.

content.latin: 18 Etenim cum essem vobíscum, per voluntátem Dei eram: ipsum benedícite, et cantáte illi.
content.english: 18 For when I was with you, I was there by the will of God: bless ye him, and sing praises to him.

segments.t: Etenim cum essem vobíscum, per voluntátem Dei eram: ipsum benedícite, et cantáte illi.

content.latin: 19 Vidébar quidem vobíscum manducáre, et bíbere: sed ego cibo invisíbili, et potu, qui ab homínibus vidéri non potest, utor.
content.english: 19 I seemed indeed to eat and to drink with you: but I use an invisible meat and drink, which cannot be seen by men.

segments.t: Vidébar quidem vobíscum manducáre, et bíbere: sed ego cibo invisíbili, et potu, qui ab homínibus vidéri non potest, utor.

content.latin: 20 Tempus est ergo ut revértar ad eum, qui me misit: vos autem benedícite Deum, et narráte ómnia mirabília eius.
content.english: 20 It is time therefore that I return to him that sent me: but bless ye God, and publish all his wonderful works.

segments.t: Tempus est ergo ut revértar ad eum, qui me misit: vos autem benedícite Deum, et narráte ómnia mirabília eius.

content.latin: 21 Et cum hæc dixísset, ab aspéctu eórum ablátus est, et ultra eum vidére non potuérunt.
content.english: 21 And when he had said these things, he was taken from their sight, and they could see him no more.

segments.t: Et cum hæc dixísset, ab aspéctu eórum ablátus est, et ultra eum vidére non potuérunt.

content.latin: 22 Tunc prostráti per horas tres in fáciem, benedixérunt Deum: et exsurgéntes narravérunt ómnia mirabília eius.
content.english: 22 Then they lying prostrate for three hours upon their face, blessed God: and rising up, they told all his wonderful works.

segments.t: Tunc prostráti per horas tres in fáciem, benedixérunt Deum: et exsurgéntes narravérunt ómnia mirabília eius.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: Te Deum
content.english: Te Deum

segments.t: Te Deum

content.latin: Te Deum laudámus: * te Dóminum confitémur.
content.english: We praise thee, O God, * we acknowledge thee to be the Lord.

content.latin: Te ætérnum Patrem * omnis terra venerátur.
content.english: All the earth doth worship thee, * the Father everlasting.

content.latin: Tibi omnes Ángeli, * tibi Cæli, et univérsæ Potestátes:
content.english: To thee all Angels cry aloud, * the Heavens, and all the Powers therein.

content.latin: Tibi Chérubim et Séraphim * incessábili voce proclámant:
content.english: To thee Cherubim and Seraphim * continually do cry.

content.latin: Fit reverentia Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus * Dóminus Deus Sábaoth.
content.english: bow head Holy, Holy, Holy * Lord God of Sabaoth;

segments.t: Fit reverentia
Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus * Dóminus Deus Sábaoth.

content.latin: Pleni sunt cæli et terra * maiestátis glóriæ tuæ.
content.english: Heaven and earth are full * of the Majesty of thy glory.

content.latin: Te gloriósus * Apostolórum chorus,
content.english: The glorious company of the Apostles * praise thee.

content.latin: Te Prophetárum * laudábilis númerus,
content.english: The goodly fellowship of the Prophets * praise thee.

content.latin: Te Mártyrum candidátus * laudat exércitus.
content.english: The noble army of Martyrs * praise thee.

content.latin: Te per orbem terrárum * sancta confitétur Ecclésia,
content.english: The holy Church throughout all the world * doth acknowledge thee;

content.latin: Patrem * imménsæ maiestátis;
content.english: The Father, * of an infinite Majesty.

content.latin: Venerándum tuum verum * et únicum Fílium;
content.english: Thine honourable, true, * and only Son;

content.latin: Sanctum quoque * Paráclitum Spíritum.
content.english: Also the Holy Ghost, * the Comforter.

content.latin: Tu Rex glóriæ, * Christe.
content.english: Thou art the King of Glory, * O Christ.

content.latin: Tu Patris * sempitérnus es Fílius.
content.english: Thou art the everlasting * Son of the Father.

content.latin: Fit reverentia Tu, ad liberándum susceptúrus hóminem: * non horruísti Vírginis úterum.
content.english: During the following verse all make a profound bow: When thou tookest upon thee to deliver man, * thou didst not abhor the Virgin's womb.

segments.t: Fit reverentia
Tu, ad liberándum susceptúrus hóminem: * non horruísti Vírginis úterum.

content.latin: Tu, devícto mortis acúleo, * aperuísti credéntibus regna cælórum.
content.english: When thou hadst overcome the sharpness of death, * thou didst open the Kingdom of Heaven to all believers.

content.latin: Tu ad déxteram Dei sedes, * in glória Patris.
content.english: Thou sittest at the right hand of God, * in the glory of the Father.

content.latin: Iudex créderis * esse ventúrus.
content.english: We believe that thou shalt come * to be our Judge.

content.latin: Sequens versus dicitur flexis genibus Te ergo quǽsumus, tuis fámulis súbveni, * quos pretióso sánguine redemísti.
content.english: Kneel for the following verse We therefore pray thee, help thy servants, * whom thou hast redeemed with thy precious Blood.

segments.t: Sequens versus dicitur flexis genibus
Te ergo quǽsumus, tuis fámulis súbveni, * quos pretióso sánguine redemísti.

content.latin: Ætérna fac cum Sanctis tuis * in glória numerári.
content.english: Make them to be numbered with thy Saints, * in glory everlasting.

content.latin: Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine, * et bénedic hereditáti tuæ.
content.english: O Lord, save thy people, * and bless thine heritage.

content.latin: Et rege eos, * et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.
content.english: Govern them, * and lift them up for ever.

content.latin: Per síngulos dies * benedícimus te.
content.english: Day by day * we magnify thee;

content.latin: Fit reverentia, secundum consuetudinem Et laudámus nomen tuum in sǽculum, * et in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: During the following verse, by local custom, all make a profound bow. And we worship thy Name * ever, world without end.

segments.t: Fit reverentia, secundum consuetudinem
Et laudámus nomen tuum in sǽculum, * et in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: Dignáre, Dómine, die isto * sine peccáto nos custodíre.
content.english: Vouchsafe, O Lord, to keep us * this day without sin.

content.latin: Miserére nostri, Dómine, * miserére nostri.
content.english: O Lord, have mercy upon us, * have mercy upon us.

content.latin: Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos, * quemádmodum sperávimus in te.
content.english: O Lord, let thy mercy lighten upon us, * as our trust is in thee.

content.latin: In te, Dómine, sperávi: * non confúndar in ætérnum.
content.english: O Lord, in thee have I trusted, * let me never be confounded.

content.latin: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi separandæ sint.
content.english: Skip the rest, unless praying separately.

segments.t: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi separandæ sint.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Deus, qui beátum Raphaélem Archángelum Tobíæ fámulo tuo cómitem dedísti in via: concéde nobis fámulis tuis; ut eiúsdem semper protegámur custódia et muniámur auxílio.
content.english: O God, Who didst give thy blessed Archangel Raphael unto thy servant Tobias to be his fellow wayfarer, grant unto us, thy servants, that the same may ever keep and shield us, help and defend us.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Ant. Missus est * Angelus Ráphaël ad Tobíam et Saram, ut curáret eos.
content.english: Ant. The Angel Raphael was sent * unto Tobias and Sara to heal them.

segments.t: Ant.
Missus est * Angelus Ráphaël ad Tobíam et Saram, ut curáret eos.

content.latin: Psalmus 92 [1]
content.english: Psalm 92 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 92

content.latin: 92:1 Dóminus regnávit, decórem indútus est: * indútus est Dóminus fortitúdinem, et præcínxit se.
content.english: 92:1 The Lord hath reigned, he is clothed with beauty: * the Lord is clothed with strength, and hath girded himself.

segments.t: Dóminus regnávit, decórem indútus est: * indútus est Dóminus fortitúdinem, et præcínxit se.

content.latin: 92:1 Étenim firmávit orbem terræ, * qui non commovébitur.
content.english: 92:1 For he hath established the world * which shall not be moved.

segments.t: Étenim firmávit orbem terræ, * qui non commovébitur.

content.latin: 92:2 Paráta sedes tua ex tunc: * a sǽculo tu es.
content.english: 92:2 Thy throne is prepared from of old: * thou art from everlasting.

segments.t: Paráta sedes tua ex tunc: * a sǽculo tu es.

content.latin: 92:3 Elevavérunt flúmina, Dómine: * elevavérunt flúmina vocem suam.
content.english: 92:3 The floods have lifted up, O Lord: * the floods have lifted up their voice.

segments.t: Elevavérunt flúmina, Dómine: * elevavérunt flúmina vocem suam.

content.latin: 92:3 Elevavérunt flúmina fluctus suos, * a vócibus aquárum multárum.
content.english: 92:3 The floods have lifted up their waves, * with the noise of many waters.

segments.t: Elevavérunt flúmina fluctus suos, * a vócibus aquárum multárum.

content.latin: 92:4 Mirábiles elatiónes maris: * mirábilis in altis Dóminus.
content.english: 92:4 Wonderful are the surges of the sea: * wonderful is the Lord on high.

segments.t: Mirábiles elatiónes maris: * mirábilis in altis Dóminus.

content.latin: 92:5 Testimónia tua credibília facta sunt nimis: * domum tuam decet sanctitúdo, Dómine, in longitúdinem diérum.
content.english: 92:5 Thy testimonies are become exceedingly credible: * holiness becometh thy house, O Lord, unto length of days.

segments.t: Testimónia tua credibília facta sunt nimis: * domum tuam decet sanctitúdo, Dómine, in longitúdinem diérum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Missus est Angelus Ráphaël ad Tobíam et Saram, ut curáret eos.
content.english: Ant. The Angel Raphael was sent unto Tobias and Sara to heal them.

segments.t: Ant.
Missus est Angelus Ráphaël ad Tobíam et Saram, ut curáret eos.

content.latin: Ant. Ingréssus Angelus * ad Tobíam, salutávit eum, et dixit: Gáudium sit tibi semper.
content.english: Ant. The Angel went in * unto Tobias, and said: Joy be ever with thee.

segments.t: Ant.
Ingréssus Angelus * ad Tobíam, salutávit eum, et dixit: Gáudium sit tibi semper.

content.latin: Psalmus 99 [2]
content.english: Psalm 99 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 99

content.latin: 99:2 Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * servíte Dómino in lætítia.
content.english: 99:2 Sing joyfully to God, all the earth: * serve ye the Lord with gladness.

segments.t: Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * servíte Dómino in lætítia.

content.latin: 99:2 Introíte in conspéctu eius, * in exsultatióne.
content.english: 99:2 Come in before his presence * with exceeding great joy.

segments.t: Introíte in conspéctu eius, * in exsultatióne.

content.latin: 99:3 Scitóte quóniam Dóminus ipse est Deus: * ipse fecit nos, et non ipsi nos.
content.english: 99:3 Know ye that the Lord he is God: * he made us, and not we ourselves.

segments.t: Scitóte quóniam Dóminus ipse est Deus: * ipse fecit nos, et non ipsi nos.

content.latin: 99:3 Pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius: * introíte portas eius in confessióne, átria eius in hymnis: confitémini illi.
content.english: 99:3 We are his people and the sheep of his pasture. * Go ye into his gates with praise, into his courts with hymns: and give glory to him.

segments.t: Pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius: * introíte portas eius in confessióne, átria eius in hymnis: confitémini illi.

content.latin: 99:4 Laudáte nomen eius: quóniam suávis est Dóminus, in ætérnum misericórdia eius, * et usque in generatiónem et generatiónem véritas eius.
content.english: 99:4 Praise ye his name: for the Lord is sweet, his mercy endureth for ever, * and his truth to generation and generation.

segments.t: Laudáte nomen eius: quóniam suávis est Dóminus, in ætérnum misericórdia eius, * et usque in generatiónem et generatiónem véritas eius.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Ingréssus Angelus ad Tobíam, salutávit eum, et dixit: Gáudium sit tibi semper.
content.english: Ant. The Angel went in unto Tobias, and said: Joy be ever with thee.

segments.t: Ant.
Ingréssus Angelus ad Tobíam, salutávit eum, et dixit: Gáudium sit tibi semper.

content.latin: Ant. Forti ánimo * esto, Tobía: in próximo enim est ut a Deo curéris.
content.english: Ant. Be of good courage, Tobias, * for it is nigh at hand that God shall heal thee.

segments.t: Ant.
Forti ánimo * esto, Tobía: in próximo enim est ut a Deo curéris.

content.latin: Psalmus 62 [3]
content.english: Psalm 62 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 62

content.latin: 62:2 Deus, Deus meus, * ad te de luce vígilo.
content.english: 62:2 O God, my God, * to thee do I watch at break of day.

segments.t: Deus, Deus meus, * ad te de luce vígilo.

content.latin: 62:2 Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.
content.english: 62:2 For thee my soul hath thirsted; * for thee my flesh, O how many ways!

segments.t: Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.

content.latin: 62:3 In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: * sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.
content.english: 62:3 In a desert land, and where there is no way, and no water: * so in the sanctuary have I come before thee, to see thy power and thy glory.

segments.t: In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: * sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.

content.latin: 62:4 Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.
content.english: 62:4 For thy mercy is better than lives: * thee my lips shall praise.

segments.t: Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.

content.latin: 62:5 Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.
content.english: 62:5 Thus will I bless thee all my life long: * and in thy name I will lift up my hands.

segments.t: Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.

content.latin: 62:6 Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.
content.english: 62:6 Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness: * and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips.

segments.t: Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.

content.latin: 62:7 Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adiútor meus.
content.english: 62:7 If I have remembered thee upon my bed, I will meditate on thee in the morning: * because thou hast been my helper.

segments.t: Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adiútor meus.

content.latin: 62:8 Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.
content.english: 62:8 And I will rejoice under the covert of thy wings: my soul hath stuck close to thee: * thy right hand hath received me.

segments.t: Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.

content.latin: 62:10 Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.
content.english: 62:10 But they have sought my soul in vain, they shall go into the lower parts of the earth: * they shall be delivered into the hands of the sword, they shall be the portions of foxes.

segments.t: Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.

content.latin: 62:12 Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui iurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.
content.english: 62:12 But the king shall rejoice in God, all they shall be praised that swear by him: * because the mouth is stopped of them that speak wicked things.

segments.t: Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui iurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Forti ánimo esto, Tobía: in próximo enim est ut a Deo curéris.
content.english: Ant. Be of good courage, Tobias, for it is nigh at hand that God shall heal thee.

segments.t: Ant.
Forti ánimo esto, Tobía: in próximo enim est ut a Deo curéris.

content.latin: Ant. Benedícite Deum cæli, * et coram ómnibus vivéntibus confitémini illi, quia fecit vobíscum misericórdiam suam.
content.english: Ant. Bless ye the God of Heaven, * and confess Him before all living, for He hath had mercy upon you.

segments.t: Ant.
Benedícite Deum cæli, * et coram ómnibus vivéntibus confitémini illi, quia fecit vobíscum misericórdiam suam.

content.latin: Canticum Trium Puerorum [4]
content.english: Canticle of the Three Young Men [4]

segments.t: Canticum Trium Puerorum

content.latin: 3:57 Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:57 All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:58 Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cæli, Dómino.
content.english: 3:58 O ye angels of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye heavens, bless the Lord:

segments.t: Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cæli, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:59 Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.
content.english: 3:59 O all ye waters that are above the heavens, bless the Lord: * O all ye powers of the Lord, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:60 Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.
content.english: 3:60 O ye sun and moon, bless the Lord: * O ye stars of heaven, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:61 Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.
content.english: 3:61 O every shower and dew, bless ye the Lord: * O all ye spirits of God, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:62 Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.
content.english: 3:62 O ye fire and heat, bless the Lord: * O ye cold and heat, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:63 Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.
content.english: 3:63 O ye dews and hoar frosts, bless the Lord: * O ye frost and cold, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:64 Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.
content.english: 3:64 O ye ice and snow, bless the Lord: * O ye nights and days, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:65 Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.
content.english: 3:65 O ye light and darkness, bless the Lord: * O ye lightnings and clouds, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:66 Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:66 O let the earth bless the Lord: * let it praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:67 Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.
content.english: 3:67 O ye mountains and hills, bless the Lord: * O all ye things that spring up in the earth, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:68 Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.
content.english: 3:68 O ye fountains, bless the Lord: * O ye seas and rivers, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:69 Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.
content.english: 3:69 O ye whales, and all that move in the waters, bless the Lord: * O all ye fowls of the air, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:70 Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.
content.english: 3:70 O all ye beasts and cattle, bless the Lord: * O ye sons of men, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:71 Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:71 O let Israel bless the Lord: * let them praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:72 Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.
content.english: 3:72 O ye priests of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye servants of the Lord, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:73 Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ iustórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.
content.english: 3:73 O ye spirits and souls of the just, bless the Lord: * O ye holy and humble of heart, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ iustórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:74 Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:74 O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless ye the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:75 (Fit reverentia:) Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:75 (Bow head) Let us bless the Father and the Son, with the Holy Ghost; * let us praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: 3:75 (Fit reverentia:)
Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:56 Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:56 Blessed art thou, O Lord, in the firmament of heaven: * and worthy of praise, and glorious for ever.

segments.t: Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.

content.latin: Ant. Benedícite Deum cæli, et coram ómnibus vivéntibus confitémini illi, quia fecit vobíscum misericórdiam suam.
content.english: Ant. Bless ye the God of Heaven, and confess Him before all living, for He hath had mercy upon you.

segments.t: Ant.
Benedícite Deum cæli, et coram ómnibus vivéntibus confitémini illi, quia fecit vobíscum misericórdiam suam.

content.latin: Ant. Pax vobis, * nolíte timére: Deum benedícite, et cantáte illi.
content.english: Ant. Peace be unto you, * fear not, bless ye God, and give praise to Him.

segments.t: Ant.
Pax vobis, * nolíte timére: Deum benedícite, et cantáte illi.

content.latin: Psalmus 148 [5]
content.english: Psalm 148 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 148

content.latin: 148:1 Laudáte Dóminum de cælis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.
content.english: 148:1 Praise ye the Lord from the heavens * praise ye him in the high places.

segments.t: Laudáte Dóminum de cælis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.

content.latin: 148:2 Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes eius.
content.english: 148:2 Praise ye him, all his angels: * praise ye him, all his hosts.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes eius.

content.latin: 148:3 Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.
content.english: 148:3 Praise ye him, O sun and moon: * praise him, all ye stars and light.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.

content.latin: 148:4 Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.
content.english: 148:4 Praise him, ye heavens of heavens: * and let all the waters that are above the heavens, praise the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.

content.latin: 148:5 Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
content.english: 148:5 For he spoke, and they were made: * he commanded, and they were created.

segments.t: Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.

content.latin: 148:6 Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.
content.english: 148:6 He hath established them for ever, and for ages of ages: * he hath made a decree, and it shall not pass away.

segments.t: Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.

content.latin: 148:7 Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.
content.english: 148:7 Praise the Lord from the earth, * ye dragons, and all ye deeps:

segments.t: Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.

content.latin: 148:8 Ignis, grando, nix, glácies, spíritus procellárum: * quæ fáciunt verbum eius:
content.english: 148:8 Fire, hail, snow, ice, stormy winds * which fulfill his word:

segments.t: Ignis, grando, nix, glácies, spíritus procellárum: * quæ fáciunt verbum eius:

content.latin: 148:9 Montes, et omnes colles: * ligna fructífera, et omnes cedri.
content.english: 148:9 Mountains and all hills, * fruitful trees and all cedars:

segments.t: Montes, et omnes colles: * ligna fructífera, et omnes cedri.

content.latin: 148:10 Béstiæ, et univérsa pécora: * serpéntes, et vólucres pennátæ:
content.english: 148:10 Beasts and all cattle: * serpents and feathered fowls:

segments.t: Béstiæ, et univérsa pécora: * serpéntes, et vólucres pennátæ:

content.latin: 148:11 Reges terræ, et omnes pópuli: * príncipes, et omnes iúdices terræ.
content.english: 148:11 Kings of the earth and all people: * princes and all judges of the earth:

segments.t: Reges terræ, et omnes pópuli: * príncipes, et omnes iúdices terræ.

content.latin: 148:12 Iúvenes, et vírgines: senes cum iunióribus laudent nomen Dómini: * quia exaltátum est nomen eius solíus.
content.english: 148:12 Young men and maidens: let the old with the younger, praise the name of the Lord: * For his name alone is exalted.

segments.t: Iúvenes, et vírgines: senes cum iunióribus laudent nomen Dómini: * quia exaltátum est nomen eius solíus.

content.latin: 148:14 Conféssio eius super cælum et terram: * et exaltávit cornu pópuli sui.
content.english: 148:14 The praise of him is above heaven and earth: * and he hath exalted the horn of his people.

segments.t: Conféssio eius super cælum et terram: * et exaltávit cornu pópuli sui.

content.latin: 148:14 Hymnus ómnibus sanctis eius: * fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi.
content.english: 148:14 A hymn to all his saints: to the children of Israel, a people approaching him.

segments.t: Hymnus ómnibus sanctis eius: * fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Pax vobis, nolíte timére: Deum benedícite, et cantáte illi.
content.english: Ant. Peace be unto you, fear not, bless ye God, and give praise to Him.

segments.t: Ant.
Pax vobis, nolíte timére: Deum benedícite, et cantáte illi.

content.latin: Quando orábas cum lácrimis, et sepeliébas mórtuos, et derelinquébas prándium tuum, et mórtuos abscondébas per diem in domo tua, et nocte sepeliébas eos, ego óbtuli oratiónem tuam Dómino.
content.english: Then thou didst pray with tears, and didst bury the dead, and didst leave thy dinner, and didst hide the dead in thine house through the day, and bury them in the night, I offered up thy prayer before the Lord.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: Hymnus
content.english: Hymn

segments.t: Hymnus

content.latin: Placáre, Christe, sérvulis,
content.english: O Christ, Redeemer of us all,

content.latin: Quibus Patris cleméntiam
content.english: Protect thy servants when they call,

content.latin: Tuæ ad tribúnal grátiæ
content.english: And hear with reconciling care

content.latin: Patróna Virgo póstulat.
content.english: The Blessed Virgin's holy prayer.

content.latin: Nobis adésto, Archángele,
content.english: Be ever present, Angel high,

content.latin: Dei medélam dénotans:
content.english: Whose name doth healing signify:

content.latin: Morbos repélle córporum,
content.english: From bodily ills protect us sure,

content.latin: Affer salútem méntibus.
content.english: And keep our souls in health secure.

content.latin: Et vos, beáta per novem
content.english: And ye, O ever blissful throng

content.latin: Distíncta gyros ágmina,
content.english: Of heavenly spirits, guardians strong,

content.latin: Antíqua cum præséntibus,
content.english: Our past and present ills dispel,

content.latin: Futúra damna péllite.
content.english: From future peril shield us well.

content.latin: Auférte gentem pérfidam
content.english: From lands wherein thy faithful dwell

content.latin: Credéntium de fínibus,
content.english: Drive far the trait'rous infidel;

content.latin: Ut unus omnes únicum
content.english: So we to Christ due hymns of praise

content.latin: Ovíle nos pastor regat.
content.english: Henceforth with gladsome hearts we raise.

content.latin: Deo Patri sit glória,
content.english: To God the Father, praise be done,

content.latin: Qui, quos redémit Fílius,
content.english: Who doth redeem us by his Son,

content.latin: Et Sanctus unxit Spíritus,
content.english: Anoint us by his Holy Ghost,

content.latin: Per Angelos custódiat.
content.english: And guard us by his Angel-host.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi, Deus meus.
content.english: ℣. Before the Angels will I sing praise unto thee, O my God.

segments.t: In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi, Deus meus.

content.latin: ℟. Adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo.
content.english: ℟. I will worship toward thy holy Temple, and praise thy Name.

segments.t: Adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo.

content.latin: Ant. Ego sum Ráphaël Angelus, * qui asto ante Dóminum: vos autem benedícite Deum, et narráte ómnia mirabília eius, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. I am the Angel Raphael * who stand before the Lord; but bless ye God, and tell of all His wondrous works, alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Ego sum Ráphaël Angelus, * qui asto ante Dóminum: vos autem benedícite Deum, et narráte ómnia mirabília eius, allelúia.

content.latin: Canticum Zachariæ
content.english: Canticle of Zacharias

segments.t: Canticum Zachariæ

content.latin: 1:68 Benedíctus ✠ Dóminus, Deus Israël: * quia visitávit, et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ:
content.english: 1:68 Blessed be the Lord ✠ God of Israel; * because he hath visited and wrought the redemption of his people:

segments.t: Benedíctus ✠ Dóminus, Deus Israël: * quia visitávit, et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ:

content.latin: 1:69 Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.
content.english: 1:69 And hath raised up an horn of salvation to us, * in the house of David his servant:

segments.t: Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.

content.latin: 1:70 Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:
content.english: 1:70 As he spoke by the mouth of his holy Prophets, * who are from the beginning:

segments.t: Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:

content.latin: 1:71 Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.
content.english: 1:71 Salvation from our enemies, * and from the hand of all that hate us:

segments.t: Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.

content.latin: 1:72 Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.
content.english: 1:72 To perform mercy to our fathers, * and to remember his holy testament,

segments.t: Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.

content.latin: 1:73 Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:
content.english: 1:73 The oath, which he swore to Abraham our father, * that he would grant to us,

segments.t: Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:

content.english: 1:75 In holiness and justice before him, * all our days.

segments.t: Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:

segments.t: Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:

content.english: 1:78 Through the bowels of the mercy of our God, * in which the Orient from on high hath visited us:

segments.t: Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:

content.latin: 1:79 Illumináre his, qui in ténebris, et in umbra mortis sedent: * ad dirigéndos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
content.english: 1:79 To enlighten them that sit in darkness, and in the shadow of death: * to direct our feet into the way of peace.

content.latin: Deus, qui beátum Raphaélem Archángelum Tobíæ fámulo tuo cómitem dedísti in via: concéde nobis fámulis tuis; ut eiúsdem semper protegámur custódia et muniámur auxílio.
content.english: O God, Who didst give thy blessed Archangel Raphael unto thy servant Tobias to be his fellow wayfarer, grant unto us, thy servants, that the same may ever keep and shield us, help and defend us.

content.latin: Iam lucis orto sídere,
content.english: Now in the sun's new dawning ray,

content.latin: Deum precémur súpplices,
content.english: Lowly of heart, our God we pray

content.latin: Ut in diúrnis áctibus
content.english: That he from harm may keep us free

content.latin: Nos servet a nocéntibus.
content.english: In all the deeds this day shall see.

content.latin: Linguam refrénans témperet,
content.english: May fear of him our tongues restrain,

content.latin: Ne litis horror ínsonet:
content.english: Lest strife unguarded speech should stain:

content.latin: Visum fovéndo cóntegat,
content.english: His favouring care our guardian be,

content.latin: Ne vanitátes háuriat.
content.english: Lest our eyes feed on vanity.

content.latin: Sint pura cordis íntima,
content.english: May every heart be pure from sin

content.latin: Absístat et vecórdia;
content.english: And folly find no place therein:

content.latin: Carnis terat supérbiam
content.english: Scant need of food, excess denied,

content.latin: Potus cibíque párcitas.
content.english: Wear down in us the body's pride.

content.latin: Ut, cum dies abscésserit,
content.english: That when the light of day is gone,

content.latin: Noctémque sors redúxerit,
content.english: And night in course shall follow on.

content.latin: Mundi per abstinéntiam
content.english: We, free from cares the world affords,

content.latin: Ipsi canámus glóriam.
content.english: May chant the praise that is our Lord's.

content.latin: Deo Patri sit glória,
content.english: All laud to God the Father be,

content.latin: Eiúsque soli Fílio,
content.english: All praise, Eternal Son, to thee:

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
content.english: All glory, as is ever meet,

content.latin: Nunc et per omne sǽculum.
content.english: To God the holy Paraclete.

content.latin: 93:1 Deus ultiónum Dóminus: * Deus ultiónum líbere egit.
content.english: 93:1 The Lord is the God to whom revenge belongeth: * the God of revenge hath acted freely.

segments.t: Deus ultiónum Dóminus: * Deus ultiónum líbere egit.

content.latin: 93:2 Exaltáre, qui iúdicas terram: * redde retributiónem supérbis.
content.english: 93:2 Lift up thyself, thou that judgest the earth: * render a reward to the proud.

segments.t: Exaltáre, qui iúdicas terram: * redde retributiónem supérbis.

content.latin: 93:3 Úsquequo peccatóres, Dómine, * úsquequo peccatóres gloriabúntur:
content.english: 93:3 How long shall sinners, O Lord: * how long shall sinners glory?

segments.t: Úsquequo peccatóres, Dómine, * úsquequo peccatóres gloriabúntur:

content.latin: 93:4 Effabúntur, et loquéntur iniquitátem: * loquéntur omnes, qui operántur iniustítiam?
content.english: 93:4 Shall they utter, and speak iniquity: * shall all speak who work injustice?

segments.t: Effabúntur, et loquéntur iniquitátem: * loquéntur omnes, qui operántur iniustítiam?

content.latin: 93:5 Pópulum tuum, Dómine, humiliavérunt: * et hereditátem tuam vexavérunt.
content.english: 93:5 Thy people, O Lord, they have brought low: * and they have afflicted thy inheritance.

segments.t: Pópulum tuum, Dómine, humiliavérunt: * et hereditátem tuam vexavérunt.

content.latin: 93:6 Víduam, et ádvenam interfecérunt: * et pupíllos occidérunt.
content.english: 93:6 They have slain the widow and the stranger: * and they have murdered the fatherless.

segments.t: Víduam, et ádvenam interfecérunt: * et pupíllos occidérunt.

content.latin: 93:7 Et dixérunt: Non vidébit Dóminus, * nec intélleget Deus Iacob.
content.english: 93:7 And they have said: The Lord shall not see: * neither shall the God of Jacob understand.

segments.t: Et dixérunt: Non vidébit Dóminus, * nec intélleget Deus Iacob.

content.latin: 93:8 Intellégite, insipiéntes in pópulo: * et stulti, aliquándo sápite.
content.english: 93:8 Understand, ye senseless among the people: * and, you fools, be wise at last.

segments.t: Intellégite, insipiéntes in pópulo: * et stulti, aliquándo sápite.

content.latin: 93:9 Qui plantávit aurem, non áudiet? * aut qui finxit óculum, non consíderat?
content.english: 93:9 He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? * or he that formed the eye, doth he not consider?

segments.t: Qui plantávit aurem, non áudiet? * aut qui finxit óculum, non consíderat?

content.latin: 93:10 Qui córripit gentes, non árguet: * qui docet hóminem sciéntiam?
content.english: 93:10 He that chastiseth nations, shall he not rebuke: * he that teacheth man knowledge?

segments.t: Qui córripit gentes, non árguet: * qui docet hóminem sciéntiam?

content.latin: 93:11 Dóminus scit cogitatiónes hóminum, * quóniam vanæ sunt.
content.english: 93:11 The Lord knoweth the thoughts of men, * that they are vain.

segments.t: Dóminus scit cogitatiónes hóminum, * quóniam vanæ sunt.

content.latin: 93:12 Beátus homo, quem tu erudíeris, Dómine: * et de lege tua docúeris eum,
content.english: 93:12 Blessed is the man whom thou shalt instruct, O Lord: * and shalt teach him out of thy law.

segments.t: Beátus homo, quem tu erudíeris, Dómine: * et de lege tua docúeris eum,

content.latin: 93:13 Ut mítiges ei a diébus malis: * donec fodiátur peccatóri fóvea.
content.english: 93:13 That thou mayst give him rest from the evil days: * till a pit be dug for the wicked.

segments.t: Ut mítiges ei a diébus malis: * donec fodiátur peccatóri fóvea.

content.latin: 93:14 Quia non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: * et hereditátem suam non derelínquet.
content.english: 93:14 For the Lord will not cast off his people: * neither will he forsake his own inheritance.

segments.t: Quia non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: * et hereditátem suam non derelínquet.

content.latin: 93:15 Quoadúsque iustítia convertátur in iudícium: * et qui iuxta illam omnes qui recto sunt corde.
content.english: 93:15 Until justice be turned into judgment: * and they that are near it are all the upright in heart.

segments.t: Quoadúsque iustítia convertátur in iudícium: * et qui iuxta illam omnes qui recto sunt corde.

content.latin: 93:16 Quis consúrget mihi advérsus malignántes? * aut quis stabit mecum advérsus operántes iniquitátem?
content.english: 93:16 Who shall rise up for me against the evildoers? * or who shall stand with me against the workers of iniquity?

segments.t: Quis consúrget mihi advérsus malignántes? * aut quis stabit mecum advérsus operántes iniquitátem?

content.latin: 93:17 Nisi quia Dóminus adiúvit me: * paulo minus habitásset in inférno ánima mea.
content.english: 93:17 Unless the Lord had been my helper, * my soul had almost dwelt in hell.

segments.t: Nisi quia Dóminus adiúvit me: * paulo minus habitásset in inférno ánima mea.

content.latin: 93:18 Si dicébam: Motus est pes meus: * misericórdia tua, Dómine, adiuvábat me.
content.english: 93:18 If I said: My foot is moved: * thy mercy, O Lord, assisted me.

segments.t: Si dicébam: Motus est pes meus: * misericórdia tua, Dómine, adiuvábat me.

content.latin: 93:19 Secúndum multitúdinem dolórum meórum in corde meo: * consolatiónes tuæ lætificavérunt ánimam meam.
content.english: 93:19 According to the multitude of my sorrows in my heart, * thy comforts have given joy to my soul.

segments.t: Secúndum multitúdinem dolórum meórum in corde meo: * consolatiónes tuæ lætificavérunt ánimam meam.

content.latin: 93:20 Numquid adhǽret tibi sedes iniquitátis: * qui fingis labórem in præcépto?
content.english: 93:20 Doth the seat of iniquity stick to thee, * who framest labour in commandment?

segments.t: Numquid adhǽret tibi sedes iniquitátis: * qui fingis labórem in præcépto?

content.latin: 93:21 Captábunt in ánimam iusti: * et sánguinem innocéntem condemnábunt.
content.english: 93:21 They will hunt after the soul of the just, * and will condemn innocent blood.

segments.t: Captábunt in ánimam iusti: * et sánguinem innocéntem condemnábunt.

content.latin: 93:22 Et factus est mihi Dóminus in refúgium: * et Deus meus in adiutórium spei meæ.
content.english: 93:22 But the Lord is my refuge: * and my God the help of my hope.

segments.t: Et factus est mihi Dóminus in refúgium: * et Deus meus in adiutórium spei meæ.

content.latin: 93:23 Et reddet illis iniquitátem ipsórum: et in malítia eórum dispérdet eos: * dispérdet illos Dóminus, Deus noster.
content.english: 93:23 And he will render them their iniquity: and in their malice he will destroy them: * the Lord our God will destroy them.

segments.t: Et reddet illis iniquitátem ipsórum: et in malítia eórum dispérdet eos: * dispérdet illos Dóminus, Deus noster.
